title: oscore observe profile: no-PIV notification rejection is stricter than RFC 8613 4.1.3.5 - document deliberate deviation
description: Found by 3x codereview of the rust-oscore observe port (9liz unblock work). begin_unprotect_observe_response rejects every notification without an explicit PIV (InvalidParam, /home/mark/crates/oscore/src/lib.rs:1292-1296). RFC 8613 s4.1.3.5 permits the FIRST response to an Observe registration to omit the Partial IV (nonce from the request), so a fully RFC-compliant server's first notification would be dropped. The stricter behavior is a deliberate fail-closed choice: with the request-PIV one-shot guard bypassed for notifications, allowing no-PIV notifications would alias the AEAD nonce across notifications. Action: record the deviation in the LICHEN observe profile / spec security section so the C implementation and interop vectors agree with it deliberately (C side must also always include a fresh PIV per notification).
